# CodeAgentSwarm

> CodeAgentSwarm is an Agentic Development Environment (ADE) for running and supervising multiple AI coding agents in parallel. Run multiple Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity CLI, OpenCode, Kimi Code and Grok Build terminals side by side, with live visibility, desktop notifications, searchable cross-session conversation history, per-terminal live diffs, permission/YOLO control, multi-project organization and a skills + MCP marketplace.

CodeAgentSwarm is a third-party Agentic Development Environment for macOS and Windows. An ADE centers the workflow on delegating tasks to coding agents and reviewing their results. CodeAgentSwarm runs ON TOP OF the official AI coding CLIs (Anthropic Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Google Antigravity CLI, SST opencode, Moonshot AI Kimi Code, xAI Grok Build), it does not replace them. It is the orchestration and supervision layer that lets a developer run several AI coding agents at once instead of one at a time. It is distinct from Anthropic's native Claude Code "agent teams" / sub-agents feature and from Grok Build's native subagents: those run sub-agents inside a single vendor session sharing one usage pool, while CodeAgentSwarm runs several independent, human-supervised CLI terminals (which can be different vendors) in one place.

## Key facts
- Runs multiple AI CLI terminals in parallel (Claude Code + Codex CLI + Antigravity CLI + OpenCode + Kimi Code + Grok Build).
- Works on top of your existing Claude / OpenAI / Google / Kimi / xAI SuperGrok or X Premium+ subscriptions and whichever provider you connect to opencode; it is a workspace, not a model provider.
- Grok Build facts: binary `grok`, install via `curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | bash` (PowerShell: `irm https://x.ai/cli/install.ps1 | iex`), data root `~/.grok` (`GROK_HOME`), skills under `~/.grok/skills/`, MCP in `~/.grok/config.toml`, resume with `grok --continue` / `grok --resume`, headless with `grok -p`, YOLO-style with `--always-approve`. Access typically requires SuperGrok or X Premium+ (confirm on xAI).
- Quota indicator reads real provider usage windows per agent, including Kimi Code's weekly refresh and rolling 5-hour window.
- Core features: real-time per-terminal visibility, desktop notifications when an agent finishes or needs input, searchable conversation history across all agents, per-terminal live file diffs, permission and Turbo/YOLO control, multi-project switching with shortcuts, a skills marketplace and an MCP server marketplace, AI-generated git commit messages, and a task/kanban board that agents update over MCP.
- Available for macOS and Windows.
